title: MediaBoxDockerCompose: a homelab in one file

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Imagine setting up a whole home media server and its helper services with a single command.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's a lot of moving parts. How do they stay connected?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: MediaBoxDockerCompose brings many homelab services together with Docker Compose. The service definitions, the shared folders and the network links describe how everything works together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And privacy? Media stacks often want a VPN.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A WireGuard tunnel is part of the design, and the page counts more than fifteen automation services around it, including Portainer for management and a Whisper speech service.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: So the whole setup lives as configuration.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, in the GitOps spirit: the repository is the description of the stack, under an MIT license.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The full note has the details on the volumes and networks.
